# CYBOU

CYBOU is an open-source project building an identity-centered protocol and
desktop software for private messaging and user-controlled files. It is
experimental software, not a public mail or cloud-storage service.

## Current status

- The active protocol is deployed on the experimental DEV network.
- The deployed DEV network operates a legacy testnet topology (`cybou-node.service`
  finalizer on port 29461 and two storage providers on ports 29471/29481). It is
  maintained for routine development until planned acceptance tests and a
  coordinated new-genesis cutover replace it.
- Finality is single-operator hybrid-PQ PoA; full nodes independently validate
  blocks, state roots, and certificates. This is a centralized trust model,
  **not BFT**, and the network makes no Byzantine fault tolerance claim.
- The protocol substrate includes account Identity, `.cybou` names,
  `RootPublication`, an encrypted ROOT/INDEX/DATA chunk tree, finalized chunk
  admission proofs, and CYP2 block/chunk transport.
- Mail and Files are not complete public services. Publication construction,
  discovery/indexing, retrieval, clean-machine restore, provider selection,
  measured replication, audit and repair are integrated. Sustained soak and
  clean-install desktop Beta acceptance remain open. DEV requires one remote
  replica; Beta requires two independent remote replicas; local cache is excluded.
- DEV pins the X-Wing / HPKE IETF draft-05 profile. This is DEV-only and is not
  an external security audit or production guarantee.

## Architecture rules

- All participants run the same full-node software (`CybouNode`). Bootstrap,
  storage, advisory Validation, and PoA finalization are optional local capabilities,
  not protocol node classes.
- Genesis authorizes 1–4 bootstrap Identities by stable `AccountID` and expected
  `RecoveryKeyID`. Bootstrap nodes provide rendezvous and relay; they do not vote,
  form a quorum, or finalize.
- The Central Authority is identified only by possession of the genesis PoA key;
  its finalizer runs from its desktop after vault unlock. Its route is ephemeral
  per session.
- Public P2P admission is France-only in production and DEV (inbound and outbound)
  using local Geo data (fails closed). Optional VPN/proxy/Tor filtering is local
  operator policy and never changes consensus.
- `RootPublication` is the only application-content publication operation.
- Mail, Files, Backup, names, recipients, and application schemas are encrypted
  client payloads; no permanent per-message or per-file consensus objects.
- Chunk IDs use the full BLAKE3-256 hash of stored encrypted bytes.
- Providers require valid inclusion proofs against finalized publications.
- Finality authorizes admission; it does not prove availability or durability.
- Clients own rebuildable Inbox, Sent, and Files indexes.
- No runtime compatibility layer or dual operation decoder for the superseded
  protocol is part of the active architecture.

## Product direction

- Mail aims for familiar Gmail workflows with private publications and
  attachments through the shared application substrate.
- Files aims for familiar Google Drive workflows on the same encrypted content
  substrate.
- Attachments depend on measured storage durability and recovery.
- Backup is post-Beta.
- Optional Validation is signed advisory evidence any full node may provide.
  Recipients verify and trust it locally; it has no canonical effects. A local
  Authority threshold of 1,000,000 may label an opinion validator-qualified,
  but never admits a node or changes finality. Only PoA finalizes.
- CYP2 v3 uses TLS 1.3; provider and finalizer role proofs are bound to the TLS
  session. Ordinary peers do not have global authenticated identities.

## Documentation hierarchy

- Level 0 (Implementation authority): `AGENTS.md`
- Level 1 (Frozen decisions / architecture): `docs/cybou/24_DECISIONS.md`, `docs/cybou/02_ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Level 2 (Normative domain specs): `04_NETWORK_LIFECYCLE.md`, `POA_FINALITY.md`, `37_FRANCE_SOVEREIGN_NETWORK_POLICY.md`, `ROOT_PUBLICATION.md`, `ENCRYPTED_CHUNK_TREE.md`, `STORAGE_ADMISSION.md`, `57_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY.md`, etc.
- Level 3 (Implementation status): `docs/cybou/26_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md`
- Level 4 (Roadmap): `docs/cybou/22_ROADMAP.md`, `25_OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`
- Level 5 (Product contracts): `docs/cybou/82_MAIL_UI_UX.md`, `83_STORAGE_UI_UX.md`, `85_BETA_UI_ACCEPTANCE.md`

Do not describe CYBOU as a public production service, BFT network, or completed
Gmail/Google Drive replacement.
